evidence.quote: ADB SAFEGATE now launches a new distributed control and monitoring solution for airfield lighting control and monitoring systems (ALCMS) that will set new industry standards.
At inter airport Europe 2019, ADB SAFEGATE announces one of the most advanced, flexible and adaptable multilateration (MLAT) products to improve approach and ground surveillance at airports.
The launch of the updated Power HF at inter airport follows a successful field test at Brussels Airport.
